chapter: Casa, Zeb Lenard and Little Joe
title: Albert Martin, taken from one band and put in Vincent's
summary: Vincent says he took Albert Martin out of another band and into his own. After Vincent went to Mexico the band separated and Albert went to Texas.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Ask him about Albert Martin. How about Albert Martin?

Albert Martin? Well, he used to play with me and Ali when he was there. He used to play with Judy Forstain. Oh yeah. But I took him away from Judy Forstain and got him with Ali. And then he played with other bands after I didn't rent. I left my rent to Mexico. Then when I come back, my job was right there for me. But then after that, I didn't get a break with fake Marvel. And he said he was going to take it like I take and rent to Mexico. And that's why we all separated. And Albert, he went to Texas. The family got lucky that I didn't get all the money. He worked with Don Alba too. Texas. We put about two traps that come all the way through. What about Little Joe? What about Little Joe? The trumpet player?
